verdict.rationale: Logseq documents a `logseq://` URI protocol for quick capture from browsers or command-line shell, and a local HTTP APIs server explicitly built for external access to the graph with authorization, directly enabling scripting/workflow integration from outside the app. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the HTTP API and URI scheme in real workflows, and explicit documentation of opening/navigating to specific existing notes (not just quick-capture) via deep link.
